summary.name: Show Bar
summary.one_liner: Show Bar is a free, notarized macOS menu-bar utility that adds window-level Command-Tab switching with live thumbnails, Dock hover window previews, keyboard window snapping, clipboard history, and a screenshot shelf with markup.
use_cases: switch between individual windows of the same app on macOS
preview open windows by hovering Dock icons
tile windows into halves or corners with keyboard shortcuts
search and reuse clipboard history on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Replaces the native Command-Tab switcher with live thumbnail previews of individual windows, including Desktop/Space tags for windows on other spaces. Shows thumbnails of an app's open windows when hovering its Dock icon, supporting bottom, left, and right Dock placements. Snaps windows to halves, corners, thirds, or maximize using Control-Option with arrow keys. Stores clipboard history (Control-Option-V) with search for text, rich text, links, and images, kept on-device. Pins new screenshots in a floating corner shelf with a markup editor and a Copy All batch paste.
notable: Windows-style Dock hover window previews for macOS
Command-Tab switches between windows rather than apps, with live thumbnails
Apple-notarized direct download, also on Mac App Store and Homebrew cask
caveats: Full Dock hover previews and Command-Tab replacement require the Direct Download (.dmg) version, which needs Accessibility permission outside the App Sandbox; the Mac App Store version is more limited
Live previews require Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or 15 Sequoia, as stated in the page header
